description: Consolidated mechanistic model of human PLPBP: cytosolic PLP carrier, handover to apo-enzymes, and the two failure modes on loss of function
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch, FancyBboxPatch
import numpy as np

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12.5, 7.0))
ax.set_xlim(0,100); ax.set_ylim(0,100); ax.axis("off")

def box(x,y,w,h,text,fc,ec="#333333",fs=9,bold=False):
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x,y),w,h,boxstyle="round,pad=0.6",
                 facecolor=fc,edgecolor=ec,linewidth=1.1))
    ax.text(x+w/2,y+h/2,text,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=fs,
            fontweight="bold" if bold else "normal",color="#1a1a1a")

def arrow(x1,y1,x2,y2,color="#444444",style="-|>",lw=1.4,ls="-"):
    ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((x1,y1),(x2,y2),arrowstyle=style,color=color,
                 lw=lw,linestyle=ls,mutation_scale=13,shrinkA=2,shrinkB=2))

ax.text(50,96,"Human PLPBP (PROSC / PLPHP, O94903): cytosolic PLP carrier",
        ha="center",fontsize=13,fontweight="bold")
ax.text(50,91.5,"Salvage pathway input on the left, cofactor handover in the centre, failure modes on the right",
        ha="center",fontsize=9,color="#555555")

# ---- salvage pathway ----
box(2,70,17,8,"Pyridoxine / pyridoxamine\n/ pyridoxal (diet)","#E8E8E8")
box(2,55,17,8,"PNP / PMP / PL","#DCE9F5")
box(2,40,17,8,"PLP\n(free, reactive aldehyde)","#C7DBEF")
arrow(10.5,70,10.5,63.5); ax.text(11.5,66.5,"PDXK",fontsize=8,color="#1f4e79",fontweight="bold")
arrow(10.5,55,10.5,48.5); ax.text(11.5,51.5,"PNPO",fontsize=8,color="#1f4e79",fontweight="bold")

# ---- PLPBP ----
box(33,40,24,23,"PLPBP\nfold-type III TIM barrel\nPLP in Schiff base at K47\nsolvent-exposed, exchangeable","#F6C6C6",ec="#B22222",fs=10,bold=True)
arrow(19,44,33,48)
ax.text(26,50.5,"loads",fontsize=8,ha="center")

# ---- apoenzymes ----
box(68,52,29,11,"Apo PLP-dependent enzymes\nGAD1/2, DDC, ABAT, GLDC,\nSHMT, aminotransferases","#D7EBD4")
arrow(57,53,68,57); ax.text(62.5,59,"hands off PLP",fontsize=8,ha="center",color="#2d6a2d",fontweight="bold")
box(68,38,29,9,"Holoenzymes active:\nGABA, dopamine, serotonin,\none-carbon and amino acid flux","#D7EBD4")
arrow(82.5,52,82.5,47.5)

# ---- protection from phosphatase ----
box(33,24,24,8,"PDXP (pyridoxal phosphatase)","#EFE0C0")
arrow(45,40,45,32.5,color="#B22222",style="-[",lw=1.6)
ax.text(46.5,36,"shielded while bound",fontsize=8,color="#B22222")

# ---- failure modes ----
ax.text(50,16.5,"When PLPBP is lost (biallelic variants: EPEO1, MIM 617290)",
        ha="center",fontsize=10,fontweight="bold",color="#B22222")
box(2,3,29,11,"Free PLP hydrolysed faster\nby PDXP  ->  low PLP\n(low CSF PLP and pyridoxal)","#F9E0E0")
box(35,3,29,11,"PNP and PMP accumulate\nPNP competitively blocks\nGcvP/GLDC  ->  hyperglycinemia","#F9E0E0")
box(68,3,29,11,"Neonatal seizures, lactic\nacidemia; responsive to\npyridoxine / PLP","#F9E0E0")
arrow(31.5,8.5,35,8.5); arrow(64,8.5,68,8.5)
arrow(45,40,16.5,14.5,color="#B22222",ls="--",lw=1.2)
arrow(45,40,49.5,14.5,color="#B22222",ls="--",lw=1.2)

# ---- evidence annotations ----
ax.text(2,86,"Localisation: cytosol (HPA IF, Enhanced; GO:0005829 IDA).\nNo cleavable mitochondrial presequence (net +2 with 2 acidic\nresidues; 0th percentile of 15 matrix proteins, p = 0.0004).\nMitochondrial B6 phenotype is downstream.",
        fontsize=8,va="top",color="#333333",
        bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.4",fc="#F2F2F2",ec="#CCCCCC"))
ax.text(62,86,"Conservation: 29 reviewed orthologues, mean 43.5% identity to human.\n12 strictly invariant residues; 6 within 10 A of K47 NZ\n(hypergeometric p = 2.0e-4; Mann-Whitney p = 4.6e-6).\nK47 aligns to E. coli YggS Lys36.",
        fontsize=8,va="top",color="#333333",
        bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.4",fc="#F2F2F2",ec="#CCCCCC"))
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
